name: DentiSystems - GATE Zero-Trust Threat & Injection Intercepted

properties.displayName: DentiSystems - GATE Zero-Trust Threat & Injection Intercepted
properties.description: Detects SQL injection, OS command injection, XSS, or prompt injection payloads intercepted and blocked by the DentiSystems GATE edge reverse proxy.
properties.query:
DENTIGRIDThreats_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| where Platform_s =~ 'GATE' or Signature_s has_any ('SQL Injection', 'Command Injection', 'XSS', 'Prompt Injection', 'Schema Violation', 'BMS Override')
| extend IPCustomEntity = SourceIP_s
| extend URLCustomEntity = URL_s
| project TimeGenerated, IPCustomEntity, URLCustomEntity, Signature_s, Method_s, SourceCountry_s, NodeID_s
